title: Keyboard input, resize, audible PipeWire audio, transactional scene hot-swap

scope.objective: Execute the remaining immediately-executable Wave-2 packages: keyboard text input, window resize, real audible audio output, and transactional hot-swap — the Wave-2 gate criteria.

implementation_record.notes: wl_keyboard with evdev US subset (correct evdev codes: q..p 16-25, a..l 30-38, z..m 44-50 non-contiguous explicit table); resize reallocates shm pool; PwCatOutput streams float32 WAV to pw-cat/paplay/aplay child stdin with graceful degradation; SceneStore transactional swap unit-tested; runtime displays typed state.

results.audio: REAL audible output verified: 880 Hz tap, 12000/12000 samples, state=Available via pw-cat
results.hotswap_live: good edit hot-swapped to generation 2; broken edit rejected with running scene retained — Wave-2 gate criterion met live
results.regressions: fusion 10/10, buttons 9/9, hello headless proof pass
results.uni: 92/100 exit 0 (after fixing traci-flagged panic paths: parser unwrap-after-peek, IR root unwrap, example/example unwraps — all replaced with explicit error arms)

test_evidence.environment: rustc 1.95.0 pinned, Wayland session, PipeWire running

notable_findings.evdev_gaps: Letter rows are not ASCII-contiguous across keyboard gaps (a..l then semicolon); the z-row is not contiguous at all — explicit tables required, caught by key-table unit tests.
notable_findings.traci_value: traci flagged three genuine panic paths introduced this wave (production resolve().unwrap(), expect() in demo paths, test-only unwraps); all fixed with explicit error arms — the observability advisor caught real defects again.
